summary: Receives image data from NDI-enabled applications over IP, with support for source selection, extra search IPs, bandwidth selection, hardware decode for NDI HX where available, and color-space handling.

key_params.name: extraips
key_params.note: Space-separated IPs for sources not reachable by mDNS

key_params.name: bandwidth
key_params.note: high or low bandwidth receive mode

key_params.name: hwdecode
key_params.note: Hardware decode for supported NDI|HX streams

key_params.name: inputcolorspace
key_params.note: automatic, srgb, rec709, rec2020, aces, passthrough, and related spaces

key_params.name: inputreferencewhite
key_params.note: default, sdr, or hdr reference-white handling

key_params.name: audiobuflen
key_params.note: Audio buffer length for paired NDI audio workflows

common_gotchas: Windows firewall settings can block NDI discovery or connection.
hwdecode only applies to NDI|HX/H264 streams, not native NDI streams sent by TouchDesigner NDI Out TOP.
Sources outside the local mDNS reach need extraips entries.
NDI is low latency but high bandwidth, so network capacity matters.
The official docs mention NDI In DAT in metadata prose, but the operator here is NDI In TOP.
key_concepts: Receives NDI video streams over IP into TOP images.
Discovery uses mDNS by default and can be expanded with Extra Search IPs for remote networks.
Bandwidth and hardware decode settings trade quality, CPU/GPU use, and stream compatibility.
Metadata can be received through Info DAT/XML DAT workflows, and audio is handled by Audio NDI CHOP.
Input color-space and reference-white controls convert received data into the working color space.
